title: Second Sandbar | KEY.co
description_expanded: Ascending to the second floor reveals a space bathed in natural light, where the outdoor hues seamlessly blend with the interior's tasteful design. A queen bedroom with an en-suite walk-in shower adds to the allure, providing guests with a private haven. The heart of the home, a gourmet kitchen equipped with stainless steel appliances and casual bar seating, invites guests to engage in culinary adventures. Adjacent to the kitchen, a strategically placed dining table allows for meals accompanied by spectacular seaside views. Further enhancing the outdoor living experience, the balcony features comfortable chaise lounges and a dining set, ideal for enjoying the refreshing coastal breeze and the rhythmic sound of the waves. This recently remodeled in 2023 and boasting interiors by the acclaimed Toby West, epitomizes coastal elegance. Gracing the cover of Veranda Magazine, this home captures the essence of luxury with its panoramic views and vibrant colors that echo the beauty of the Emerald Coast. On the first floor, guests find solace in two exquisite queen bedrooms, each complemented by private bathrooms, ensuring privacy and comfort. The master suite elevates the notion of indulgence with premium linens, a spa-like bathroom featuring a soaking tub and shower, and a serene ambiance ideal for unwinding. Additionally, the newly added side deck with a fire pit offers a perfect setting for cherished vacation memories under the stars.
